title: Secure AI Code Library — Rule
description: JSON Schema for files under registry/rules/**/*.rule.yaml. Enforces the two-layer token-economy contract (summary <= 300 chars, content markdown body), required source citations, and Mythos substantiation vocabulary. Field ordering in YAML files should follow the property declaration order below to preserve KV-cache prefix stability (see docs/TOKEN-ECONOMICS.md and ADR 0005).

id.description: Kebab-case identifier. MUST match the filename without the .rule.yaml suffix.

description.description: Optional one-line description. Distinct from summary (which is the agent-facing imperative).

version.description: Semantic version of this rule's content contract. See SPEC.md section 4.2.

category.description: Mirrors the parent directory under registry/rules/. Optional in metadata if the path implies it.

severity.description: Default severity for this rule's findings. Top-level (must not be nested inside metadata).

summary.description: REQUIRED. Layer 1 always-on surface. <=300 chars (~80 tokens). Imperative voice: 'do X; reject Y; rationale Z'. Loaded into IDE always-on context (Tier 0) or scope-glob-activated (others).

extends.description: OPTIONAL. References a parent rule id. Adapter merges parent's summary+content first; this file ships only the delta. Per-language rules extend cross-language parents; framework specs extend language rules.

items.description: OWASP ASVS v5 section ID, e.g. '5.1.3'.
ISO/IEC 42001:2023 control, e.g. 'A.9.1'. AI-governance rules SHOULD declare at least one.
MITRE ATLAS technique ID, e.g. 'AML.T0051'. AI-governance rules SHOULD declare these where applicable; CI warns on missing.

pillar.description: Which CSA Mythos-Ready pillar this rule contributes to.

substantiation.description: REQUIRED. 'substantiated' = end-to-end in this repo (requires non-empty evidence). 'aligned' = partially implemented (a roadmap milestone names the path to full implementation). 'roadmap' = placeholder for a roadmap milestone, not enforced today.

evidence.description: Required when substantiation=substantiated. Repo-relative file paths verifying the implementation.

roadmap_milestone.description: When substantiation in {aligned, roadmap}, names the milestone in docs/MYTHOS.md (e.g. 'M2').

primary.description: REQUIRED. Non-empty list of primary citations. Each entry must resolve to docs/SOURCES.md allowlist (standards section IDs, dated threat-intel reports, or allowlisted URLs).

threat_intel.description: Optional. Dated public threat-intel references. Must be on docs/SOURCES.md allowlist. NEVER vendor announcements as statistics.

always_apply.description: Tier 0 rules set true. All others default false.

globs.description: Activation triggers. Adapter loads the rule when matching files are in agent context.

content.description: REQUIRED. Layer 2 on-demand surface. Full markdown body: Principle -> Rationale -> BAD/GOOD examples -> Checklist -> References. Section ordering frozen by template (see CONTRIBUTING.md and ADR 0005).

deprecated.description: Deprecation flag. Deprecated rules remain in INDEX with a (deprecated) suffix for at least one MINOR cycle before removal (see SPEC.md section 4.5).

deprecated_in.description: Library version in which this rule was deprecated.
